work_groups.title: Whole frame/coherence, raw pixels and frame-input contract
remaining_work: Scoped local native evidence covers direct Python and JSON frame controls, saved scripts and cold format 6 replay. It verifies latched origin, partial raster continuation, held typematic IRQs, foreign-epoch refusal and the full matched Doom timedemo raster. The retained timed 320x200 profile still needs the wider legacy consumer and mode contracts, including downstream source-depth differences.

Format 5 restores the opt-in standard Mode 13h initial and steady phase. The separate format 7 profile reproduces the paired standard same-mode BIOS overlap and restores both callback deadlines. Qualify additional dynamic programming sequences.

Paired text, planar and banked VBE renderer capture and point probes pass. Format 8 adds 480-row timed scanout and restore for Mode 12h and banked VBE 101h. The separate format 9 profile restores guest VBE 101h status-port phase on the same virtual clock as timed scanout. Format 10 adds retrace-latched banked VBE 101h display starts and restores an in-flight BIOS wait with the current and pending pages. Format 11 adds horizontal panning at independent coarse and fine retrace latches and preserves their pending deadlines through restore. Format 12 commits combined X/Y requests atomically and restores either of the two pending latch stages. Format 13 adds banked 101h stride and DAC controls, plus timed palette restore. With the alternate 4F0Ah firmware it also restores the guest inside the relocated VBE 2.0 palette and display-start waits. Format 14 adds packed 8-bit linear VBE 101h through the reported PCI aperture and restores the sampled raster, framebuffer bytes and the two pending viewport deadlines. Separate VBE 4F04h firmware restores the saved guest display controls and palette while preserving its current VRAM. A format 14 checkpoint also retains the guest buffer until the guest issues 4F04h restore. The separate VBE compatibility ROM bounds controller and mode-info writes, reports 101h banked and linear page capacity, rejects a bank beyond the advertised range before changing the aperture, and checks the palette transfer span before DAC access. Its normal 4F00h, 4F01h, 4F05h and 4F09h calls have a paired DOSBox-X witness; unsupported bank and secondary-palette responses differ from the pinned S3 BIOS and remain explicit parity exceptions. Additional video layouts and their frame-input contracts remain open.
